title: Dotnet Full Stack Developer
jobDescription: Official GITA IT role on the verified first-party page: Dotnet Full Stack Developer. Job summary: Must be very strong in .NET core MVC. Full stack development experience with C#, ASP.NET MVC, and Web API. Working experience in Web services (SOAP/Restful) integration, failure analysis etc... Hands-on development experience using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS 3, AJAX, JSON, Bootstrap, and Angular(optional). SQL Server Knowledge or experience in SQL. Understanding of back-end technologies. Good Communication and analytic skills. Good Ttime-management skills. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills. You will be working closely with the UI, UX and QA team. A technology enthusiast who is passionate about coding. Willing to learn, unlearn and relearn. Be a team player. Key skills: ASP.Net Core, Web API, Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server, Angular. Hiring contact: mohan.r@gitait.com.

title: Reactjs and React Native web-developer
jobDescription: Official GITA IT role on the verified first-party page: Reactjs and React Native web-developer. Job summary: Build pixel-perfect, UI across both web and mobile platforms. Design, develop, secure high performing applications using Reactjs, ReactNative for both web & mobile. Translate designs & wireframes into a high-quality code & UI. Leverage native APIs for deep integrations with both platforms. Diagnose, fix bugs & performance bottlenecks that feels native. Reach out to the open source community to encourage & help implement mission-critical software fixes - React Native moves fast & often breaks things. Maintain code & write automated tests to ensure the product is of the highest quality Skills Responsibilities: 2-4 years software development experience. Hands on experience in Reactjs, React Native, Redux. Firm grasp of the JavaScript language & its nuances, including ES6 syntax. Object-oriented programming. Write well-documented, clean JavaScript code. Working with third-party dependencies and debugging dependency conflicts. Familiarity with native build tools, like XCode, Android Studio. Understanding of REST APIs, the document request model, & offline storage. Experience with automated testing suites, like Jest. Key skills: Reactjs, React Native, ES6, xcode, restapi, android studio, Jest.
